name: Renekton
notes: Opens by casting Dominus (R) at t=0 for the full 15 s of aura ticks and its 20 Fury on cast; Renekton then attacks continuously and casts Q, W and E on cooldown.
Fury starts the fight at 0 (no pre-fight stacking is modeled) and is never capped except for Dominus' own passive generation, which is capped at 75 Fury as stated.

At 50+ Fury, whichever of Q or W is cast next consumes 50 Fury for its empowered effect and generates no Fury from that cast; we do not hold either ability's cast to bias which one gets the empowerment, since both cooldowns are short enough that Fury banks up roughly every cycle regardless of order.

The dummy never damages Renekton, so his health never drops below the 50% threshold: Reign of Anger's bonus Fury generation while low never triggers, and Slice and Dice's recast never gets the 'Reign of Anger Bonus' (extra damage + armor shred), since Reign of Anger's own text explicitly excludes Slice and Dice from Fury-empowerment and the only other documented trigger (low health) never occurs. Slice and Dice's damage is therefore always its base value on both the dash and the recast.

Ruthless Predator (W) is cast on cooldown; it arms the next basic attack to strike twice (thrice if it consumes 50 Fury) instead of dealing the engine's normal auto-attack damage, and resets the attack timer on cast. Only the first strike can critically strike and is tagged as ability damage; the cooldown starts when the empowered attack lands ('post-effect').

Slice and Dice (E) is cast on cooldown and its free recast (Dice) is taken immediately after the dash lands, since nothing is gained by delaying it within its 4 s window; each of the two instances generates its own Fury.

Dominus' per-tick magic damage uses the numbers-sheet-derived base [30/75/120] (AuraDamagePerSecond [60/150/240] halved for the 0.5 s tick rate) rather than the wiki's mismatched 4-value listing, since it reconciles exactly with the wiki's own +5% bonus AD / +5% AP per-tick ratios.

Ruthless Predator's buff-duration disagreement (6 s bin vs 7 s wiki) is not modeled explicitly: the ability resets the attack timer, so the empowered attack always lands within a fraction of a second of the cast, well inside either window.
The documented Fury-clawback bug on empowered Ruthless Predator's third strike is not modeled; Fury accrues normally.

Cull the Meek's 0.25 s post-cast lockout on attacks is modeled with the engine's standard cast-lockout; its extra 0.25 s lockout on casting Slice and Dice/Dominus is not modeled separately since it is far shorter than either ability's cooldown and essentially never binds.
The estimated 0.2 s cast time on Ruthless Predator's empowered attack and its follow-up 0.525 s lockout on Q/E are not modeled: both are unconfirmed ('Estimated') and small relative to the fight.
Fury's 12 s out-of-combat decay never triggers since Renekton is always in combat (continuously attacking) during the fight. Mana/cost is not modeled since every ability costs 0.
